context: A police officer briefs an exec on VIP security
purpose: Teach: 来訪/実業/セットアップ/省エネ/一線/下位/浮かび/帳簿

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 海外来訪者、警察庁でも認知しています。
lines.en: We're aware of the overseas visitor at the NPA level.
lines.style: Professional, measured opening. Even cadence. Factual delivery — no inflection wasted. Eye-contact steady, the tone of someone who has briefed many people and knows what matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。実業界の重鎮で、安全配慮、最優先です。
lines.en: Yes. He's a major industry figure, so safety is our top priority.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Clear agreement without obsequiousness. Slight weight on 「safety」— shows understanding of the stakes. Cooperative but not deferential.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警備のセットアップ、省エネ系の機器も使用しますか。
lines.en: For the security setup, will we be using energy-efficient equipment as well?
lines.style: Measured procedural question. No rush. Tone suggests this is protocol, not doubt. Slight lift at the end — genuine inquiry, not confirmation-seeking.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。一線級の警備員、下位スタッフへの指示、共有しています。
lines.en: Yes. Our frontline guards have the full briefing, and we've distributed the instructions down the chain.
lines.style: Assured, matter-of-fact. Confidence in the system without sounding rehearsed. Steady pace. The tone of someone who has ensured coordination and knows the information has reached where it needs to.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 帳簿、不審な動きが浮かび上がらないか、確認します。
lines.en: I'll review the records to make sure nothing suspicious shows up.
lines.style: Quiet, final note. The understated close of someone checking one last thing. Measured pace, no urgency — just thoroughness. Slight pause before the period, like he's already mentally moving to the next step.
